body:
The #1462 follow-up moved the *config dir* onto a single source of truth
(`app_paths.config_dir()`, which now matches `cps.constants.CONFIG_DIR`), and
converted the two log-file paths in `convert_library.py` and
`kindle_epub_fixer.py` onto it. Sibling paths were deliberately left on the
literal, because they belong to container-lifecycle services a source install
does not currently run, and widening the diff would have made the
reporter-facing fix harder to review:

- `scripts/auto_zip.py:18` — `/config/processed_books/`
- `scripts/convert_library.py:83,459` — `/config/processed_books`, failed/
- `scripts/ingest_processor.py:418,478,486` — processed_books roots
- `scripts/ingest_processor.py:602,606` — batch dirty/active markers (these at
  least have `CWA_INGEST_BATCH_*` env overrides)
- `scripts/cwa_db.py:66,436` — `CWA_DB_PATH` defaults to `/config/`
- `scripts/generate_book_checksums.py:63` — same
- `scripts/kindle_epub_fixer.py:429` — processed_books/fixed_originals

Impact: a source install that wires up the ingest service (which @Thovi98's
YunoHost package is heading towards) writes these to the filesystem root, or
fails to. The mechanical fix is the same one-line substitution already applied
to the log files: `str(app_paths.config_dir() / "...")`.

Separately, `check_for_app_db()` matches `"app.db" in f` against the whole path
rather than the basename, so `/config/backup/app.db.bak` counts as a live
database and suppresses seeding. Pre-existing; not touched here because
changing the match semantics is a behaviour change for existing installs and
wants its own red test.
title: scripts/ still hardcodes /config for processed_books, cwa.db and ingest batch markers
